notes.title: Dedicated Server Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Dedicated Server Release Now Live


Realmwalkers, our new Dedicated Servers are now live. To get started, download this update and create a new character or download one of your online characters to play. You can choose to play solo, join, or host a Friend.


Your online characters will continue to be hosted by Inflexion and will be available to download for up to a year. For more information about this update, please check out our last blog post here.


Release Highlights

Dedicated Servers - Use our new Dedicated Servers to host or join a friend! We have also partnered with GPortal for paid hosting.

Start Menu - The start menu has been re-organized to make it easier to create a new character and then choose how you want to play

Online Character Download - You can now download your online characters to be used offline directly from the Start Menu. 

Admin Panel - You can enable some of the debug tools and cheats our team finds helpful if you want to experiment with Nightingale. You can find more information about how to do this on our FAQs page here: https://playnightingale.com/faqs

Monikers! - You can now earn titles for your Realmwalkers that are displayed under your username.  Find the Moniker that represents who you are in Nightingale—from the classic Realmwalker and the accomplished Network Weaver to the whimsical Chuckaboo and the chaotic Rapscallion.

Nightingale Dedicated Servers – Powered by GPORTAL

Our upcoming Dedicated Server release gives you the flexibility to play Nightingale how you want, whether you prefer to host your own Realm or play with friends.

To make this possible, we’ve partnered with GPORTAL to provide  easy-to-use servers around the globe. With GPORTAL, setting up and managing your own server is quick and seamless so you can focus on exploring, building, and surviving in the Fae wilds.



Additional Bug Fixes and Updates



Gameplay

Item Rewards: Players now automatically receive the Cleansing Card when its requirements are met

Fishing & Store: Fishing mini-games have been adjusted and issues in the Porter Pistol shop purchase have been fixed

Weapon Effects: The Ultimate Sickle weapon’s bleed damage has been reworked for clarity

Updated outfits and appearances of several NPCs

Building swapping - In placement mode, added the ability to swap targeted structures with the new structure, with resources being refunded and/or dropped to ground. Tileset pieces and hanging lights/decorations can be swapped out with tileset pieces of the same type (eg. doorframe and a doorframe, but not a doorframe and a wall). Freestanding structures can be swapped if their size matches.

Improved issues when swapping weapons



UI & UX

Connect Screen: The Continue button on the host/connect screen now only activates when an address is entered

A Previous/Next host button has been added for easier navigation.

Moniker Support: A new Moniker tab in the player Inventory lets you set custom name titles, and those monikers now show on player nameplates

Profile Picker: You can now create more then 4 characters in profile creation

Travel UI: Clicking the opposite arrows on the travel map will now cycle travel direction, and the travel HUD groups “Accept”/“Decline” actions together for clarity

Ultimate charms now use tier coloration

Fix for BodyTypes in character creation


Social Features

Parties: Parties are now based on who is on a server.

Players now see on-screen notifications when someone joins or leaves their party

Party Voting: A new Party Voting system lets group members vote on quick travel destinations.

Friend Join: Steam friends can now join your game when you host (via Steam relay)

Travel Invites: New safeguards automatically deny a travel invite if the host is still on the Continue Journey screen

Removed non-functional respite permissions 


Performance and Stability

Addressed a GPU crash that was occurring on some systems.

Optimized creature spawning



Audio

New spatial audio for Provisioners Borough, the Docks, the Portal Transcept Spire in The Watch

New audio for The Watch Pale Suppression Quest


Bug Fixes

Quests & Rewards: Corrected a quest description (“A Gate to the Void”) and fixed a bug where a reward room’s teacup item was missing

Environment: Resolved several minor world glitches (e.g. blocked holes in city districts). Players can no longer get stuck in a hidden room due to level geometry issues

Other Fixes: The portal activation button in the Vaults area now works correctly, and various UI tooltip and text issues have been cleaned up (such as leftover “XP/Masterwork” labels)

Audio: Fixed an echo-related audio bug in one quest area (Sunken Hope cathedral)

Fix for collectible busts that weren’t previously collectible

Fixed missing teacup from reward set

Fixed characters falling if attacked while swimming

Fixed zone control VFX not happening in multiplayer

Fixed magic realm card buff to correctly apply damage bonus

Fixed item stacking not taking into account all characteristics

Fixed the torches in the Crossways to no longer flicker

Fix bug where crafts would not finish in offline mode after restoring from persistence

Fixed a mismatch of tiers for Dumplings

Fixed the description of Immolation

Fixed the description of Tudor Stove and Regency Stove

Fixed an issue where Masterwork Bow Arms could be used as Poles

Fixed incorrect recipe component for Masterwork Longbow

Fixed an issue where dialogue options were missing when multiple players turned in a quest at the same time

Family lineage will now persist

Memory puzzles being solved concurrently will no longer interfere with each other

Rescue NPCs who get stuck can now return to navigable terrain

Fixed portal activation not working in Boss champers and Vaults

notes.title: Nightingale June Update
notes.notes:
Realmwalkers,
It’s been a few months since our Nightingale City update and we wanted to take a moment to step back and share where things stand, not just with Nightingale but with some of the broader work going on at Inflexion. More than anything, we want to share how we’re approaching the road ahead.

A lot of our recent work has focused on long-term planning for Inflexion. That of course includes Nightingale, but also other projects we’re exploring as a studio. It’s not always the most visible kind of work, but it’s important, especially now given the realities of today’s games industry. Taking the time to plan well means we can keep developing the games we love.
Reflections on Nightingale
Nightingale has been at the center of many of those conversations. We care deeply about this game. It’s ambitious and complex, and we’ve poured a lot into it. It hasn’t always been easy, but we believe in its potential and in the community that’s come with us this far.

One of the biggest considerations has been our online architecture. From Nightingale’s earliest days, we aimed to create a shared-world experience that let groups of players join together to adventure in the Fae Wilds. The back-end architecture we created delivered that vision, with players connecting realms to other realms with magical portals. The team did a great job. But at the same time it meant constraints and limitations on our overall development speed and on gameplay elements that we’ve never resolved. Now with  more than a year of early access, it's clear that many players prefer to play solo or with a few close friends, further complicating what we do going forward.

The other difficult truth is Nightingale’s review status on Steam. It’s nobody’s job but ours to make a game worthy of good reviews. But we’ve been sitting at “Mixed” for a while now, and that hurts because it reflects a gap between what we want the game to be and how it’s being received. Steam reviews matter because they shape how new players see the game and we know we have work to do if we’re going to improve them.
What We’re Doing Next
To address the first challenge, we’re nearly ready to release our dedicated server. This has been in the works for a while, and it will allow you to host a dedicated server the way you do with many other survival games: privately, reliably, and on your own terms, while still enjoying diving realmdiving from realm to realm through portals you build or discover. We’ll have more to say about the specifics on that soon.

As for the Steam review score and the broader player experience, that’s a bigger challenge. There’s no single feature or fix that will solve it. But we’re spending this summer focused on finding the right path forward, one grounded in what we’ve learned since Nightingale's launch.
Thank You
If you’ve played Nightingale, left feedback, or even just kept an eye on what we’re doing, thank you. We’ll keep sharing more in the weeks ahead as we prepare for our next update, and we’ll continue doing the work to make Nightingale a game worth your time and support.



Take care,

The Realmwalkers at Inflexion

notes.title: Nightingale City Update
notes.notes:
Our latest update is now live and adventures in Nightingale City awaits.

Defend Nightingale City

Humanity’s last stronghold is besieged. The Fae and their formidable Automaton Queen have unleashed chaos, and it falls to you to reclaim our home. Leap across rooftops, clear enemy-infested streets house by house, and explore the intricate network of sewers beneath the city.

Fight your way through three massive city quadrants, confront Bound invasions head-on, close the dangerous Transepts, and activate Pale Pylons to regain control. Your bravery and skill will be tested like never before when you face the fearsome Automaton Queen herself.

Alongside the City, there have been improvements to our building system, as well as, new Gear and Fabled Charms!

notes.title: Nightingale Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Nightingale Anniversary Update
Nightingale has officially reached its one-year milestone, and we’re here to celebrate with our next update. From a new dyes and customization system to tilesets and long-awaited bug fixes, this update brings plenty to help with your adventures in the Realms. 

Dyes and Customization 
One of the most anticipated features is finally here: dyes and customization! As added functionality to the Glamour Station, you now have the ability to change the materials and colors of your clothing, gear, and weapons. As soon as you unlock this station, you can start customizing.

Here’s how it works:
When you acquire an item with a specific characteristic that impacts its appearance, that characteristic is permanently unlocked at the Glamour Station.
For example, if you obtain an item with the Gold characteristic, you’ll be able to apply Gold to metals in the dye system from that point forward.
This system does not work retroactively, so you’ll need to obtain new items or pick up items you already have with desired characteristics to unlock their appearances.
For endgame players who’d rather not chase down every material, bundles of appearances are available at the Clothing Vendor in The Watch.New Tilesets, Outfits, and Furniture
This update also expands building and fashion options with a new Western themed set:
Frontier Tileset – A rugged new aesthetic for those seeking a bold frontier style.
Wrangler Outfit – A stylish new look fit for any adventurer.
New Furniture Sets – Enhance your homestead with additional pieces for the Crude and Tudor tilesets.NPC Card Game 
Looking for a break from exploring the Realms while earning some Essence? Just speak to any of the NPC Survivors to play a match card mini-game where you can bet and win Essence.

Bug Fixes and Quality-of-Life Improvements
Here are some of the most notable improvements from this update:
Fireplaces now stay lit but only consume fuel when actively crafting.
Fixed flickering and blown-out VFX, providing a more visually stable experience.
Controller fixes: LT/RT are no longer double-bound to the Estate Cairn screen.
Improved Portal Meshes: No more squashed platforms when adjusting height.
Lancaster guns now deal proper secondary ability damage.
Essence Trader in Welkin’s Reach no longer gets stuck in an endless question loop.
No more spontaneous umbrella drops! Stay airborne as intended.
Quest NPCs now behave properly, without floating grenades or potions.
Correct climbing animations when injured.
Unique crust effects on tools and weapons now work correctly.
Smoother sprinting mechanics, even when moving toward the camera.
Missing quest markers fixed: The “Talk to Nicolas” marker now appears correctly.
Firearms no longer obscure vision when using Emotes.
Predator and Prey leather/hide tiers fixed.
Improved visual variety: Each tier of plant fiber now has a distinct appearance.
Harpy and Ishmael fibers now feature their proper creature appearances.

Character Customization: Improved the appearance of lipstick; you may need to re-edit lipstick in the character creator.

notes.title: Nightingale: Winter Holiday Update
notes.notes:
Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

Watch the Winter Update Overview video here: Winter Update Trailer

As winter’s frost settles across the Faewilds, the season brings numerous new features, improvements, and festive surprises to Nightingale. With today’s Winter Update, there’s plenty to explore. Read on for the highlights of this magical winter season.


Player-Hosted Servers

Player-hosted servers are now available, offering greater flexibility in how you experience the realms with friends. Two new options await when starting the game: Host a Friend and Connect to a Friend.

Key Improvements:


 Characters are now shared between offline mode, hosting a friend, and connecting to a friend.
 Download your online characters to play on friends’ hosted servers.


Host a Friend:


 Select "Host a Friend" and enter a port number for players to connect.

 Confirm settings, choose or create a character.

 Share your IP address and port with connecting players (find your IP via tools like icanhazip.com).

 If connecting outside your LAN, forward port 7777 (or your selected port) on TCP and UDP from your router to your PC.


Connect to a Friend:


 Select "Connect to a Friend" and enter their IP address and port.

 Join their hosted game and play as usual, with the host managing realm travel approvals.


Resource Automation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/403b1c49bae6850e1c7149743a069058d5391b3b.jpg

Automate resource harvesting for your Estate using recruited Survivors! This feature will continue to evolve with future updates.

How It Works:

[olist]
 Recruit an NPC as a Survivor.

 Assign them as a Resident of your Estate.

 Build a Resource Automation Station.

 Assign an Estate Resident to the station.
[/olist]

Recruiting a Survivor:


 Interact with Survivors to obtain their Calling Cards.

 View Calling Cards in the "Calling Cards" tab of your inventory.


Estate Cairn Management:


 Access the Estate Management menu from the Estate Cairn.

 Assign up to 15 Survivors per Estate by upgrading your Cairn in the Progression menu (one Cairn per realm).


Automation Stations:

Choose from the following Resource Automation Stations in the Progression menu:


 Wood Station
 Mining Station
 Hunting Station
 Farming Station


Assign a Resident to collect resources. Only Tier 1 resource stations are available in this update, with more to come.

Winter Event

Celebrate the season with festive challenges and holiday-themed rewards! Check the Special Event tab in the Progression menu for unlock requirements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/1b0bcd6118a4617ebae383ebb10a44c765b06b23.jpg

New Weapon:

Snowballs: Unlockable via the Progression tree and craftable at the simple workbench. Use the Charm of the Brawler to enable friendly fire for snowball fights.

New Outfits & Decorations:


 Jolly Dress
 Winter Child’s Garb
 Magician Top Hat
 16 festive estate decorations


New Food Recipes:


 Roasted Seeds
 Pumpkin Pie
 Spiced Latte


New Pet:


Grimalkin


New Snow-Themed Minor Cards:


 Cozy Winter Card: A peaceful snowy realm.
 Winter Wonderland: Increased gliding speed and height, with slippery ground.
 Naughty and Nice List: Creatures will drop coal and presents.


Improved Build Mode

Building has never been easier or more immersive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/11acb417c430583fa590f41e539fe8fc75d37f93.jpg


 Press “B” to enter Build Mode.
 Switch between Search Mode (advanced functionality) and Free Mode (immersive building).
 Customize crafting benches via the Station Traits tab to apply desired Augments.


New Spells

Harness the power of the arcane with three new spells:


 Darkness: Create a shadowy orb that inflicts increased damage.
 Grasping Mire: Summon tentacles that slow and damage enemies.
 Life Drain: Absorb health from enemies to heal yourself.


Ring Course

Test your gliding skills with four new ring-gliding courses added to the Abeyance realm and Sylvan’s Cradle.

New Tileset

A festive Obsidian Tileset is now available in The Watch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/d06499dcec161e953c6ea0f0c6fbd472e4aa66cf.jpg

Additional Change Highlights


 Public Realm chat enabled.
 Fixed performance drop on Glamour Station.
 Resolved broken lighting on chandeliers.
 Charm of Brawling refresh issue fixed.
 Fixed hunger bar reset bug after eating food.
 Small violet flowers now count as “flower” resources and can be grown.
 Improved placement rules for ramps and planks.
 Fixed incorrect animation for bolt-action rifle aiming.
 Fabled Humbaba meat now spawns in Swamp Vault reward chests.
 The cold status effect is removed when players are sheltered.
 Resolved stuttering when wading in swamp water.
 Double-clicking clothing no longer unequips similar items.
 Players animate when using CapsLock for Auto Walk.
 NPCs retain health when changing areas.
 Improved collision resets for Sentinels and Sheliak in Boss Rush.


Known Issues

While the Winter Update brings many enhancements, some issues remain under investigation:

 Quests in the journal are shown as Nightingale cards.
 NPCs with blocked beds may get stuck wandering.
 Resolution change confirmation timer doesn’t work.
 On player-hosted servers, Eotens may float into the sky.
 Toggling the HUD hides boss health bars permanently.
 Inventories don't recognize controller focus until either Sort or transfer all are used (or mouse click/tap)

notes.title: Nightingale: Autumn Update
notes.notes:
Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

Details on the update below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png

Greetings, Realmwalkers!

As the amber glow of autumn skies fade, the chilling breath of winter creeps through the Faewilds. Yet, before the icy grasp takes hold, the Realms promise one final offering of the season. 

Arriving today, Nightingale’s Autumn Update brings a number of new features for intrepid Realmwalkers to explore. 

To celebrate the update, Nightingale will also be 40% off on Steam! There's never been a better time to jump into the Realms. 

Check out the gameplay overview video below:

[previewyoutube=b-6CHTCjFPU;full][/previewyoutube]

This new update also draws to a close the Halloween Event. But no need to fear about missing out on any of the event items. They’ve been added to the Progression Tree. 

More Details:

Boss Rush
You’ll be able to find the new Boss Rush challenge in The Watch. Here, you’ll be able to fight an endless series of bosses, which will each have a random Minor Realm Card effect applied. Every boss you defeat increases the difficulty of the next. 

Your reward for facing this gauntlet are new Tier 5 and Tier 6 Infusions, as well as a whole swathe of new fabled resources. Do you have what it takes to survive?

New Weapons

Swords

 Swords are now available in Nightingale! You can progress through the entire game with a new sword for each tier.
 Primary attack is a three-part combo including two slashes and a thrust.
 Secondary skill is a parry/riposte, allowing the player to parry an attack, and then complete a very powerful riposte lunge attack.


Bow Magic Arrows
The Autumn Update introduces three new types of magic arrows for the bows!

 Entangle Arrows: Arrows that entangle enemy legs with brambles to slow their advance. (Careful there are diminishing returns!)
 Implosion Arrows: Arrows that carry a delayed detonation to your enemy.
 Slicing Arrows: A dual arrow volley connected by a magical garrote that slices enemies.


Launcher

 The last new weapon in the Autumn Update is a new alternative for the slingbow: the Launcher!
 The launcher is a multiple projectile weapon, capable of being loaded with many explosive marbles at once.
 This allows the player to quickly single fire with the primary fire, or use the secondary fire to crank up a large volley of marbles at once.


FSR Frame Generation
AMD's FSR3 Frame Generation has been added as a new option to increase framerate. This feature allows your graphics card to generate additional frames through interpolation, which should significantly improve framerate; however some users may notice some input latency and subtle visual artifacts. FSR Frame Generation should be available on most hardware, and and can also be used in conjunction with any of the upscalers (TSR, FSR, DLSS, or XeSS).
Because the underlying Frame Generation systems from AMD and Nvidia can't be enabled at the same time, users who have access to DLSS Frame Generation won't see the option to enable FSR Frame Generation. If you have an Nvidia 4000 series card and would like to try running with FSR Frame Generation, you can force DLSS Frame Generation to turn off by adding this in the Launch Options in Steam's settings for Nightingale: -slnoswapchainprovider.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png

Those are the big ticket items in today’s update. However, for information on smaller changes and updates, check out the other change highlights below:

Change Highlights

Gameplay Changes

 Hitting 0 ‘Hunger’ will no longer kill you
 Hitting 25% ‘Hunger’ will still reduce your maximum health, and that effect will worsen the closer you get to 0
 Resting no longer removes your timed buffs, including food buffs

 Fix for offhand item is not hidden when reloading the revolver

AI and NPC Behavior

 Survivors can no longer be hit by characters' knife attacks


General known issues:

 Remapping the interact key makes it so the prompt no longer displays a key

Boss Rush Known Issues

notes.title: Changes to Technical Support and Troubleshooting Articles
notes.notes:
Dear Realmwalkers,

Today we’re announcing a change to game troubleshooting and support. From today, we will no longer be using Zendesk to host troubleshooting articles and support tickets. 

If you are experiencing technical issues with Nightingale, please check out the new support section of our website (https://playnightingale.com/support) for common technical troubleshooting tips.

In the case basic troubleshooting does not resolve your issue, please check search in our Aha portal (https://playnightingale.ideas.aha.io/) to see if a similar post with the issue exists with additional steps or information needed to look into the issue further. If a similar post does not already exist, please submit a new post.

Realmwalkers,

The Realms Rebuilt Update is available NOW!

[previewyoutube=-k91qf7lSEU;full][/previewyoutube]

It has been an incredible journey so far, with a path through Early Access paved by your incredible feedback. A big thank you to all the Realmwalkers who have braved the Faewilds with us since Early Access began. 

To ensure you can access the update, it's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png
0.5.0 Realms Rebuilt Change Highlights
New Content
New campaign throughline
Realmwalkers explore several new handcrafted Storied Realms
Completely revamped Sites of Power dungeons
6 new bosses
New and updated proc-gen-assisted maps (now called Untamed Realms)
Various new points of interest have been added
New encounter types have been added to the Realms
New weapons:
Short and Longbows
New Dauntless weapons (Slingbow, Lancaster Pistol, Winchester Rifle)
New Mystic weapons (Slingbow, Double-barreled Shotgun, Blunderbuss Shotgun, Lancaster Pistol, Revolver Pistol, Bolt Rifle, Lever Rifle)
New Spells: Immolation (fireball) and Fionn’s Wrath (fish missiles)
10 new Charms
Charm of The Raven: Grants an upward boost when initiating a glide.
Charm of Capoeira: Restores Stamina on your next unarmed hit after dodging.
Charm of Discharge: Increases melee damage based on how full your blocking meter is, and empties your blocking meter on melee hit.
Charm of the Haymaker: Deals a burst of damage after hitting a creature with three unarmed attacks.
Charm of the Kusarigama: Temporarily increases climbing pick damage after grappling.
Charm of the Pitcher: Empowers your throwing knives to deal more damage, but throwing them takes slightly longer.
Charm of Riposte: Increases the damage of your next knife attack after a successful parry.
Charm of Skinning: Increases the yield of resources from skinning creatures.
Charm of Thrifty Throwing: Restores a portion of a thrown weapon's Durability when you hit a weakpoint with it.
7 new Minor Cards
Foresworn skies: Decreases stealth.
Corruption:  The damage of your melee attacks is increased, but your health regeneration is severely decreased.
Greed: Increases the contents of found chests, but increases the damage you take.
Battlefield: Increases stealth, but decreases the yield of natural resources.
Will of the Wisps: Decreases maximum health and maximum stamina. Interacting with a wisp grants a stack of Wisp’s Blessing. Each stack increases maximum health and maximum stamina.
Unchained: Increases damage taken from all sources, increased further for elemental sources. Increases move speed and damage.
Nimble: Increases dodge distance and reduces dodge stamina costs. Decreases injury resist and causes blocking bar to decrease slower.
New building tile set: Regency (so elegant!)
8 new pet types have been added:
Caledonian Cat (+ Cat with a hat variant)
Caatyne
Catepelose
Meppik
Rabatte
Hyphis
Fen Rat
Eoten Sapling
Using the new Glamour station, players can use Glamour tokens they find from encounters to change the appearance of their tools, weapons, or gear to another item of the same category (for example: Dauntless Axe to Crude Axe or Calcularian Hat to Dashing Top Hat) while keeping the original item’s stats.
New character presets and loadout options

General Gameplay Adjustments
 Players can now set their Respite Point to any Realm (Storied and Untamed)
 Recruited NPCs can now pick up resources left on the ground, if you think something is missing, check their inventory to see if they picked it up!
 Recruited NPCs can now use consumables, such as potions
 Augments are no longer required to access recipes but can be used to provide bonuses to crafting
 Sticks, rocks, and grass no longer extract into Essence
 Players can set or reset the difficulty of a Realm when resting on a bed. In multiplayer, all players in the Realm must agree to the change
 The Upgrade Bench has been moved to The Watch
 Resource types and tiers have been standardized to Realm types and are no longer affected by difficulty. Higher difficulty Realms will provide more Essence
 Fast travel structures have been renamed to differentiate them. Human Lodestars are structures players can make to fast travel between other player-built Human Lodestars in a Realm. Fae Lodestars are structures that already exist in Realms to transfer between other discovered points in a Realm. Faerie Rings are unique structures that transport players from Sites of Power to boss chambers
 Throwing Knives can now skin creatures
 Climbing picks can now mine ore
 You no longer die from lack of sleep/rest
 Enchantments have been renamed to Spells for easier identification
 Up to 20 pets can now exist in a single Realm
 Traders no longer unlock recipes but carry resources that may be handy in a pinch
Combat and Balance
 As long as players have at least 1 stamina, players can now complete actions even if they don’t have the full stamina cost of the action available
 Charms can now be applied to any level tool, weapon, or gear
 Rest will allow you to replay some boss encounters
 Refined responsiveness in combat 
 The Slingbow now begins with explosive ammunition (AOE)
 A rework of how potions impact the game, and a balance update to potions
 A functionality and balance pass on minor cards and charms
 A balance update to item weight
 A balance update to enemy health and scaling
 A balance update to consumable crafting and effectiveness
 A balance update to clothing 	
 A balance update to weapons, ammo and magick
 New rare fish and a balance pass to fishing and fish stats
 Adjusts to stats on resources 
 New 4th tier of creature drops 
 Weapons and clothing only take 1 infusion 
 NPCs can use Bows, Grenades and Throwing knives
 Recruitable NPCs no longer have health scaling and rely on gear
Estate Building
 Building limits have increased. Additionally, limits have been streamlined to 2 limit types: 1. How many pieces are in a single connected structure and 2. Total items and building pieces in a Realm, weighted by data size. More details on this substantial change can be found here
 Added center-aligned shelves and decorations to tile set walls
 Structure health has been rebalanced to reduce accidental player destruction
 Recruitable NPCs no longer damage structures
 ‘Advanced Building Mode’ can be toggled on under Options-> Gameplay. When this is on, building pieces display a Building Limit Value, and the available ‘Realm Building Points’ are displayed in ‘Build Mode’
User Interface
 Players can now access up to 8 consumable items by holding the Q button
 As more consumables can be accessed via the Q radial menu, the hotbar has been changed to 7 main hand items and 3 offhand items
 Consumables now have their own tab in player inventory
 Icons for Essence tiers are now standardized across menus
 Total Essence inventory by Tier is now displayed in the TAB menu
 The bar for 'Rest' status has been removed - 'Rest' is now represented by a comfort level icon. As usual, have a snooze in bed to improve your comfort level! The comfort buff increases your Stamina and Health regen.
 The interaction reticle (previously a green or red tool/number) has been modified to be more subtle. If the crosshair/reticle is encircled an interaction is possible with your currently equipped tool, such as chopping a tree, mining ore, or picking up plant fibers but if you have the wrong tool equipped (or insufficient level of tool)  the crosshair reticle will display a little icon hint to let you know which tool you should be using.
 Food buff duration is now displayed as an icon with a progress bar
 Recruited NPC commands (behaviors, management of equipment) are now unified on one menu
 The Map screen now has a Return to Crossways button that will teleport you to your first Abeyance Realm at the Crossways point of interest
 Side-quests are no longer tracked on screen by default but can be set to ‘Tracked’ in the Journal screen
 You will now be notified in the death screen when a recruited NPC is on their way to revive you
 Storage containers now show icons (hammer/bricks) when crafting or building can draw directly from them
 The crafting menu has been redesigned. Tip: Our quantity select now supports overflow and underflow: to craft the maximum of an item, scroll to the left with the arrow icon.
 When selecting resources for a crafting recipe, you can now sort those resources by tier level (ascending/descending)
 Many of the icons in the UI have been optimized to ensure legibility at smaller sizes. You might notice this looking at schematic cards in the Guidebook, status effects icons, as well as map pins!
 Progression Menu! Unlock new recipes and structures from within this menu. It’s sorted by Tier and Category and should make it easier to track the requirements needed to unlock all the things!
 Free recipes for claiming are indicated in the Progression screen with a shiny icon visual effect
 We have removed the activity log in the bottom right of the screen. Instead, you will see a more visually present “loot notification” appear in the bottom left of your HUD
 We’ve updated the presentation for structure info on the HUD. When looking at a structure such as a Crafting Bench, its nameplate will be pinned to the HUD
 Composite structures, such as foundations, walls, roofs, will not display their name on the HUD unless the player is in ‘Build Mode’ (toggleable with the X key), if they are damaged, or pending completion
 Our accumulation bars (such as getting wet) have been moved to the bottom left of the HUD near the other status effects.
 When a negative status effect is applied it’s icon will pulse to catch the player’s attention
Technical Improvements

 Fixed a crash that could occur when felling trees
 Performance optimizations with large numbers of structures

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png

If you require technical support, please check out our player support platform. 

And if you come across bugs or have feedback for this update, check out our refreshed Aha portal here.

We look forward to your reactions and are excited to continue this journey with you!

- The Nightingale Team

notes.title: Update Regarding Players Losing Respite Realms | March 11, 2024
notes.notes:
Realmwalkers, 

Over the last few days we’ve had a few reports of progression blockers we’d like to provide updates on.

Incident Recap

 March 5th: We started getting reports that some players were falling through world maps, most of these reports were from The Watch.
 March 8th: We pushed a backend update to the servers that would detect if players were in this falling state when loading back in, and if they were deemed to be under the map, the game would force them back into their Respite Abeyance Realm. 
 March 9th: Approximately at 3:00 am MT we started getting reports that some players’ Realms seemed like they were being reset. Out of an abundance of caution, we removed the server change from the day before. After further investigation, it was deemed that the server change was not a direct cause of this issue, but as higher volumes of people were getting funneled back to their Respite, it meant more people were encountering the problem.  We attempted a server change and started Respite Realm rollback requests, but we later discovered the server change was not enough to solve the issue so additional hotfixes were investigated.
 March 10th: We pushed a game update so servers would do additional data checks before players enter a Realm. If there was a larger data discrepancy than expected, would abort loading and disconnect. If this happens, players should try to load in again. This prevented save data from being automatically overwritten in an incomplete state, but it meant that players were more likely to encounter Travel Errors. 

Current Status

 Since the emergency patch on March 10th, we have not seen any confirmed reports of players experiencing a Realm reset with valid save files after the update.
 We are continuing to track down the root issue so that we can fully address these cases that now result in a Travel Error.
 We have applied rollbacks to all those who asked for one up to 4:00pm MT on March 11.
 The issues of some players falling at The Watch are outstanding. We will be re-applying the March 8th server change as soon as possible as the new data checks are in place.
 Additional concerns or reports, such as, but not limited to, invisible walls and inconsistent build limits, are still a WIP as these are separate considerations.

Please note that if you have not logged in since 4:00pm MT on March 10th, please check if your Realm was affected before the patch.

[strike]If you have logged in as of 6:00pm MT on March 11 and your Respite Realm has been reset or a rollback request failed, please submit (or re-submit) the following form: https://forms.gle/RsDFmr2HkSH1MxWP8

Please include the following details in the notes:

 When was the last time your Respite Realm was in a good state (not reset)?
 Have you previously submitted a reset request?
 Did you have more than one Abeyance Realm?

If you share a Respite Realm with others, only one submission from your group is needed.

Once you have placed a reset request, please do not log into the character until we share the next rollback wave has been completed on our social channels (listed here).[/strike]

[March 20 Edit: Rollback requests are now closed.]

We continue to investigate additional long-term fixes and additional updates. 

Thank you for your patience and apologize again to all those affected.

- The Nightingale Team (Inflexion Games)

notes.title: Playtest Update: Surveys
notes.notes:
Hey Realmwalkers,

Today we have an update about Closed Alpha playtesting. Over the next few days we'll be sending out a survey, which you’ll need to complete for a chance to participate. Everyone who has signed up for our newsletter on our website will receive an email containing the survey. Sign-ups will remain open throughout the testing period.

Closed Alpha is our first phase of testing. Participants will gain access to an early, in-development experience to test specific aspects of gameplay, rather than the entire game. Future tests will expand the gameplay and player numbers. 

Please read the details below for more information.

How do I apply for tests?
We’ll be sending out a survey via email to those who signed up for the newsletter. You can still sign up on  our website. Keep an eye on your inbox and make sure our emails aren’t going to spam (you may want to add contact@playnightingale.com to your whitelist). 

When will playtests take place?
We’re coming up to our first planned playtest. If you’re successfully chosen to participate we will send you date and timing details. 

How many people will be selected to test?
We will be starting with a small number of people and expanding over time.

How will you be selecting who gets into tests?
There will be several factors including but not limited to: when you signed up for the newsletter, your survey answers, your system specs, game genre preferences, and community involvement.

Can I stream/take screenshots/make content about the playtest, or discuss it online?
Not at this time. As these tests do not represent the final Nightingale experience, there will be a strict NDA in place.

What if I don’t get selected for these tests?
We’re planning more playtests leading up to launch, so please keep an eye out for future communications. You will not need to reapply for future tests.

Thanks for your support! <3
